findings: Read history and Directors chapters independently first. Pre-IPO investments were secondary share transfers in April 2025; special rights row is 'Not applicable' and the sponsor states investors have same rights as public shareholders after listing. All seven directors' bios (pp225-228) contain no employment/partner/representative link to Panorama Capital Green Technology, its GP or any other pre-IPO investor; INED Luk Pui Yin Grace's past PE-related finance roles (Kleinwort Benson, Dresdner Kleinwort Capital, Ajia Partners) are historic and unrelated. Candidate quotes all verified verbatim on cited pdf pages with correct printed-page mapping. Candidate's reading follows the schema rule: affirmative evidence (pre-IPO investors exist + explicit no special rights + roster shows no link), not mere silence. Qihang vehicles are controlled by executive Director Li Bo and are not an external investor seat.
residual_uncertainty: Low. Prospectus does not literally say 'no director was nominated by a pre-IPO investor'; conclusion combines 'special rights: not applicable' with the roster review. Qihang No.1/2 being labelled Pre-IPO Investors is a controlling-shareholder vehicle issue, not a board seat.
